original_proposed_new_terms.proposed_definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carboxyspermidine + H+ = spermidine + carbon dioxide.
original_proposed_new_terms.justification: The reaction is represented by RHEA:34095 within EC 4.1.1.96. No specific active decarboxylase GO term was found by QuickGO name searches on 2026-11-05. This proposal captures the spermidine-forming reaction and does not assert carboxynorspermidine, CAPA or tetramine specificity.
